dispute.claim_text: I gave myself FIVE TIMES the travel time. He got lost, turned around three times, and dropped me at the wrong building. I lost the bus, the new ticket and my evening. The platform offered a partial goodwill payment; I'm posting this to prove that persistence works.

counterparty_statement.text: I'm new to the north side and the navigation kept re-routing. I didn't detour on purpose, I got lost. I apologised in the car. The bus ticket isn't something I can be responsible for.
